limitations: Specific regular side-two hexagonal region only.

scope_and_integrity.object: Perfect-matching complex of the 24-vertex dual honeycomb graph of a regular side-two triangular-lattice hexagon, with its natural dihedral action.
scope_and_integrity.proved: Complete ordinary rational D6 character in reduced homology, finite matching and topology certificate, and subgroup-quotient rational homology.

title: Two sign lines in honeycomb perfect-matching homology
